decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Monday to Saturday and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The building hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before 5 years from the date of commencement in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey temporary building linked to rear of health centre to provide administration offices.
